guitar.evidence: Trained knowledge: Steve Jones is famously pictured with a Gibson Les Paul Custom Black Beauty (reportedly once Mick Ronson's/Bowie associated guitar), iconic to punk history.
guitar.notes: Well-documented — should not have been unknown.

tone.target: raw punk crunch with biting upper mids
tone.profile: raw punk crunch with biting upper mids
tone.summary: A raw, aggressive punk tone achieved using a Plexi-style amp model (UK 50) combined with light overdrive and a bright 4x12 cabinet to emphasize mid-range bite.
